A physician-led path from record to report

Build the chronology. Protect the judgment.

The physician-led difference

Why Doctors Built This

Medical-legal review demands more than fast extraction. MEDEXEC combines physician-directed AI with accountable clinical review so doctors work efficiently and attorneys receive reports built to withstand scrutiny.

01

Clinical accuracy

AI trained under physician direction understands medical nuance, not just keywords.

02

Physician endorsement

Every report is reviewed and signed off by a real doctor, not just AI output.

03

Expert opinion

The reviewing physician can add their medical opinion directly to the report.

04

Built for attorneys

PI, workers’ compensation, and medical-malpractice attorneys get faster, defensible medical summaries with clear citations, physician endorsement, and optional expert opinion—no black-box AI.

Current state

In pilot. Built for proof.

MEDEXEC is being evaluated in one medical office—not presented as a broadly launched product. The pilot tests a physician-led workflow for doctors preparing IME and medical-legal reviews and for attorneys who need clear, defensible medical summaries.

What the pilot is testing

  • 01Whether physician-directed AI can organize complex case material into a clearer, cited clinical chronology.
  • 02Whether IME doctors can review, revise, endorse, and add an expert opinion more efficiently.
  • 03Whether attorneys receive a more transparent medical summary while final clinical accountability remains with the physician.
